answer_1.quote: We design a set of dialog policy models that adapt to the dialog context to appropriately control the responses at both the turn and sentence-levels.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation we compute a set of metrics between our generated and ground truth response: perplexity, BLEU-1, ROUGE-L, unigram F1-score. We also compute n-gram diversity as defined in.

answer_4.quote: We asked a set of 3 crowd workers 'Which final response is more appropriate for the given conversation?'
answer_4.guideline: Crowd workers were asked to compare responses from two models and select the more appropriate one for the dialog context.
